verdict.rationale: Browser Use publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec titled 'Browser Use Public API v4', served at api.browser-use.com/api/v4 with API-key auth. SDK docs cover creating runs, sessions, event polling and structured output, so the product can be driven fully through a documented public API. The probe's 404s on generic OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at /cloud/openapi/v4.json and is linked from llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
